key_insight: Combining adaptive tabulation with a neural-network phase-equilibrium model accelerates transcritical multiphase simulations while avoiding iterative-solver convergence failures.
engineering_relevance: The framework offers a stable, scalable route to high-pressure phase-change simulations relevant to advanced propulsion.
method: Use a pretrained ANN for phase-equilibrium evaluations during ISAT table expansion.
Retrieve tabulated states rapidly through local linear interpolation.
Redistribute tasks with an O(N) greedy load balancer and couple with adaptive mesh refinement.
evidence_signal: On a Mach 5 shock–droplet benchmark, the framework captured shock–interface dynamics without instability, delivering thermodynamic speedups of 2.30× on one core and 2.62× in parallel over standalone ANNs; AMR added a reported 2.92× overall efficiency boost.
watch_item: Accuracy beyond the demonstrated benchmark requires validation of ANN training coverage and tabulation tolerances.
paper_title: Load-Balanced Neural-Network-Aided Adaptive Tabulation of Phase Equilibria for Transcritical Multiphase Flows
